import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static class FlowEdge {
        int v, u;
        long cap, flow;
        FlowEdge(int v, int u, long cap) {
            this.v = v;
            this.u = u;
            this.cap = cap;
            this.flow = 0;
        }
    }

    static class Dinic {
        final long flow_inf = (long)1e18;
        List<FlowEdge> edges = new ArrayList<>();
        List<List<Integer>> adj = new ArrayList<>();
        int n;
        int s, t;
        int[] level;
        int[] ptr;
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();

        Dinic(int n, int s, int t) {
            this.n = n;
            this.s = s;
            this.t = t;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                adj.add(new ArrayList<>());
            }
            level = new int[n];
            ptr = new int[n];
        }

        void add_edge(int v, int u, long cap) {
            edges.add(new FlowEdge(v, u, cap));
            edges.add(new FlowEdge(u, v, 0));
            adj.get(v).add(edges.size() - 2);
            adj.get(u).add(edges.size() - 1);
        }

        boolean bfs() {
            Arrays.fill(level, -1);
            level[s] = 0;
            q.offer(s);
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int v = q.poll();
                for (int id : adj.get(v)) {
                    FlowEdge e = edges.get(id);
                    if (e.cap - e.flow <= 0 || level[e.u] != -1) continue;
                    level[e.u] = level[v] + 1;
                    q.offer(e.u);
                }
            }
            return level[t] != -1;
        }

        long dfs(int v, long pushed) {
            if (pushed == 0) return 0;
            if (v == t) return pushed;
            for (int cid = ptr[v]; cid < adj.get(v).size(); cid++) {
                ptr[v] = cid;
                int id = adj.get(v).get(cid);
                FlowEdge e = edges.get(id);
                if (level[e.u] != level[v] + 1 || e.cap - e.flow <= 0) continue;
                long tr = dfs(e.u, Math.min(pushed, e.cap - e.flow));
                if (tr == 0) continue;
                e.flow += tr;
                edges.get(id ^ 1).flow -= tr;
                return tr;
            }
            return 0;
        }

        long flow() {
            long max_flow = 0;
            while (bfs()) {
                Arrays.fill(ptr, 0);
                while (true) {
                    long pushed = dfs(s, flow_inf);
                    if (pushed == 0) break;
                    max_flow += pushed;
                }
            }
            return max_flow;
        }
    }

    static int n, t_val;
    static String[] sci;
    static String[] cap;
    static int[][] dist;
    static final int[] dx = {1, -1, 0, 0};
    static final int[] dy = {0, 0, 1, -1};
    static int[][][][][] memo;
    static boolean[][][][][] vis;

    static boolean valid(int x, int y) {
        return x >= 0 && y >= 0 && x < n && y < n && sci[x].charAt(y) != 'Y' && sci[x].charAt(y) != 'Z';
    }

    static void bfs_init(int sx, int sy) {
        dist = new int[n][n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(dist[i], -1);
        }
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(new int[]{sx, sy});
        dist[sx][sy] = 0;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cell = q.poll();
            int x = cell[0], y = cell[1];
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                int nx = x + dx[i], ny = y + dy[i];
                if (valid(nx, ny) && dist[nx][ny] == -1) {
                    dist[nx][ny] = dist[x][y] + 1;
                    q.offer(new int[]{nx, ny});
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (dist[i][j] == -1) dist[i][j] = 1000000000;
            }
        }
    }

    static boolean can_reach(int step, int x0, int y0, int x, int y) {
        if (dist[x0][y0] < step) return false;
        if (x0 == x && y0 == y) return true;
        if (step >= t_val) return false;
        if (dist[x0][y0] <= step) return false;
        if (vis[step][x0][y0][x][y]) return memo[step][x0][y0][x][y] == 1;
        vis[step][x0][y0][x][y] = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
            int nx = x0 + dx[i], ny = y0 + dy[i];
            if (nx < 0 || nx >= n || ny < 0 || ny >= n) continue;
            if (sci[nx].charAt(ny) == 'Y' || sci[nx].charAt(ny) == 'Z') continue;
            if (can_reach(step + 1, nx, ny, x, y)) {
                memo[step][x0][y0][x][y] = 1;
                return true;
            }
        }
        memo[step][x0][y0][x][y] = 0;
        return false;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String[] firstLine = br.readLine().split(" ");
        n = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[0]);
        t_val = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[1]);
        sci = new String[n];
        cap = new String[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            sci[i] = br.readLine();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            cap[i] = br.readLine();
        }

        memo = new int[65][12][12][12][12];
        vis = new boolean[65][12][12][12][12];
        for (int i = 0; i < 65; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 12; j++) {
                for (int k = 0; k < 12; k++) {
                    for (int l = 0; l < 12; l++) {
                        Arrays.fill(memo[i][j][k][l], -1);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (sci[i].charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    bfs_init(i, j);
                    goto_done_z:
                    break;
                }
            }
        }

        List<int[]> sources = new ArrayList<>();
        List<int[]> caps = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                char c = sci[i].charAt(j);
                if (c != 'Z' && c != 'Y' && c != '0') {
                    sources.add(new int[]{i, j});
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                char c = cap[i].charAt(j);
                if (c != 'Z' && c != 'Y' && c != '0') {
                    caps.add(new int[]{i, j});
                }
            }
        }

        int total_nodes = sources.size() + caps.size() + 2;
        Dinic dinic = new Dinic(total_nodes, 0, total_nodes - 1);

        for (int i = 0; i < sources.size(); i++) {
            int[] src = sources.get(i);
            long c = sci[src[0]].charAt(src[1]) - '0';
            dinic.add_edge(0, i + 1, c);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < caps.size(); i++) {
            int[] cp = caps.get(i);
            long c = cap[cp[0]].charAt(cp[1]) - '0';
            dinic.add_edge(sources.size() + 1 + i, total_nodes - 1, c);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < sources.size(); i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < caps.size(); j++) {
                int[] src = sources.get(i);
                int[] cp = caps.get(j);
                if (can_reach(0, src[0], src[1], cp[0], cp[1])) {
                    dinic.add_edge(i + 1, sources.size() + 1 + j, 10000000L);
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(dinic.flow());
    }
}
